newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay court upholds tax amnesty scheme - agency.
newsitem.headline: Bombay court upholds tax amnesty scheme - agency.

text.p: The Bombay High Court on Tuesday dismissed a public interest petition which challenged a temporary amnesty scheme for tax evaders, the Press Trust of India (PTI) news agency said.

Chief Justice M.B. Shah and Justice Ranjana Desai ruled that the Voluntary Disclosure of Income Scheme (VDIS), which waives penalties for past dodgers to draw them into the tax net, was not discriminatory to honest taxpayers.
They added that such schemes were the best way to "mop up undisclosed wealth" from a black economy, PTI said.
Private economists say at least four out of every 10 rupees earned in India are generated in the black economy and are never declared to the authorities.
